# Munich Security Conference

> > The Munich Security Conference (MSC) is a leading global forum for international security policy, convening heads of state, ministers, and experts annually in Munich to address critical challenges in European security, transatlantic relations, and defense.

The MSC hosts the annual conference at Hotel Bayerischer Hof, publishes the influential Munich Security Report analyzing geopolitical trends, and organizes high-level strategy retreats at Schloss Elmau. Key focus areas include the Ukraine war, European defense policy, NATO cooperation, and the German Zeitenwende.

## Key Topics

- Munich Security Conference (MSC)
- European Security & Defence
- Ukraine War
- Transatlantic Relations
- Munich Security Report
- NATO Strategic Communications
- Defense Innovation

- Hotel Bayerischer Hof
- EU Defense Policy

- Hybrid Threats
- Energy Security
- Foreign Policy

- [Munich Strategy Retreats](https://securityconference.org/veranstaltungen/munich-strategy-retreats): High-level off-the-record strategy retreats at Schloss Elmau
- [TUM Speakers Series](https://securityconference.org/msc-2025/tum-speakers-series): TUM Speakers Series with WHO Director-General at MSC 2025 side event
- [MSC Startup Hub](https://securityconference.org/msc-2026/oeffentliche-veranstaltungen/msc-startup-hub): MSC Startup Hub platform for defense tech with UnternehmerTUM at MSC 2026
- [BMW Foundation Energy Security Hub 2026](https://securityconference.org/msc-2026/oeffentliche-veranstaltungen/bmw-foundation-energy-security-hub): BMW Foundation Energy Security Hub at MSC 2026, Feb 12-14

## Munich Security Report & Publications

- [Chapter 1 – Introduction: Lose-Lose?](https://securityconference.org/publikationen/munich-security-report-2024/introduction): MSR 2024 introduction analyzing zero-sum thinking in post-Cold War order
- [Munich Security Brief](https://securityconference.org/publikationen/munich-security-brief): Munich Security Brief publication series on global security issues
- [Defense Budgets: Chapter 2 of "Defense Sitters — MSR Special Edition on European Defense"](https://securityconference.org/publikationen/sonderausgaben/defense-sitters/defense-budgets): Defense Budgets chapter analyzing EU military spending and capability gaps
- [Europäische Sicherheit & Technik | Special Publication: Munich Security Conference 2025](https://securityconference.org/marketplace-of-ideas/europaeische-sicherheit-technik-msc-2025): Special publication on European security, Ukraine war, and hybrid threats
- [European Security & Defence: Special Edition Munich Security Conference 2026](https://securityconference.org/marketplace-of-ideas/european-security-defence-msc-2026): ESD special edition covering key security topics from MSC 2026

## Marketplace of Ideas: Defense & Innovation

- [BCG: Overcoming the Six Unspoken Barriers That Impede Defense Innovation](https://securityconference.org/marketplace-of-ideas/bcg-overcoming-the-six-unspoken-barriers-that-impede-defense-innovation): BCG report on defense innovation barriers with MSC Innovation Board
- [NATO Strategic Communications Centre of Excellence: NextGen Information Environment](https://securityconference.org/marketplace-of-ideas/nato-stratcom-coe-nextgen-information-environment): NATO StratCom COE publication on immersive tech and information ecosystems
- [Transparency International Defence & Security: Creating Access](https://securityconference.org/marketplace-of-ideas/transparency-international-defence-security-creating-access): TI Defence toolkit on information governance and anti-corruption in defense
- [Vereinigung der Bayerischen Wirtschaft e. V.: Turbo bei der Zeitenwende zünden](https://securityconference.org/marketplace-of-ideas/vbw-turbo-bei-der-zeitenwende-zuenden): Bavarian business analysis on Germany's Zeitenwende and Ukraine support
